rule.description: A single function scope folds two construction responsibilities that belong in dedicated sub-methods: it assembles network layers in loops inside its own body (torch layer primitives or same-file classes deriving from nn.Module) while also applying two or more raw tensor-mutating weight-initialization calls (counted anywhere in the subtree so a nested closure cannot hide them), in a body of at least ten statements. Pylint message W9901, exposed through smell_check.sh.

checks.description: Detect construction entry points that keep layer/stage assembly loops and the raw weight-initialization protocol in one function scope, inlining what were dedicated builder and initializer sub-methods.
checks.detected_relation: construction entry function -> own-body layer-assembly loops + subtree raw tensor-mutating initialization calls
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The sub-method implementations of the builder and the initializer are copied into the calling scope, so one entry point owns two construction responsibilities: the module cannot be understood or refactored by moving either responsibility alone without reading deeply nested inlined logic.

matches.evidence: vgg.__init__ expands the pruning cfg into a feature-stack loop appending Conv2d/BatchNorm2d/ReLU and also runs the modules() loop calling weight.data.normal_/zero_/fill_ directly.
vgg.__init__ builds layers += [...] conv/batch-norm stacks over its cfg in a loop while directly normal_/zero_ initializing every conv, bn, and linear in the same body.

ResNet.__init__ lays out three residual stages in stage/width loops instantiating BasicBlock and wiring partial(downsample_basic_block) shortcuts, then inlines conv/bn weight initialization via normal_/fill_/zero_ in the same body.
densenet.__init__ chains dense-block units and Transition stages via growthRate/compressionRate math in nested loops, and applies normal_-family initialization to conv/bn weights in the same scope.
ResNet.__init__ walks cfg with a cursor over four stage/width loops building BasicBlock chains and Conv2d/BatchNorm2d shortcuts inline, then mutates weights with normal_/fill_/zero_ in place.

Module-level factory slimmingvgg expands its pruning config into conv/bn features in a loop, records config-derived classifier widths, and buries kaiming/fill weight initialization plus checkpoint loading in one continuing body.

ResNet.__init__ assembles three fixed-width residual stages and 1x1 conv/BatchNorm2d shortcuts in nested loops, then leaves conv/linear weight initialization via normal_/fill_ inline in the same constructor.

excluded.reason: Instance test suite (transported inside the diff so behavior is executable in every downstream container); never a production owner, systematically excluded from scanning.
Thin module-level factory that only dispatches on depth and constructs ResNet; it contains no loops or mutators of its own, so the rule correctly does not fire on it.

About two dozen training scripts in the pinned snapshot use Python 2 print statements and are unparsable by the Python 3 analyzer in every repository state; they are skipped identically in clean, injected, and repaired scans and never influence polarity.
